The engine cover features the Toyota logo and 'VVT-i 16V' text.

risks.proof: A video of the engine running or a compression test report.

risks.proof: Customs clearance papers or original shipping manifest.

proof_requests: Video of the engine starting and running.
Clear photo of the engine serial number/model code stamped on the block.
Photos of the engine with the top plastic cover and valve cover removed to check for sludge.
Scanned copy of the customs papers for the 'Direct America' claim.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a Toyota VVT-i engine. While the seller's claims of it being 'neat' are contradicted by the visible grime, and the working condition is unproven, it can be priced at its worst-case value as a local used engine in unknown condition.
